title: Glowing Elements - red
description:
this texture pack adds glowing borders on the inventory and hotbar with diffrent recolors:
CYBER - Green, PURPLE, BLUE, RED
body:
## GLOWING ELEMENTS 
is a sleek, modern texture pack designed to make your Minecraft interface shine—literally. It enhances the classic inventory and hotbar visuals with vibrant, glowing borders that come in multiple recolors: Cyber (Green), Purple, Blue, and Red. Each version gives your game a different kind of energy, from the cool futuristic glow of Cyber Green to the intense, fiery edge of Red.
This pack focuses on subtle yet striking details, keeping the familiar Minecraft look while giving it a high-tech, illuminated twist. Whether you’re building futuristic cities, exploring caves, or fighting through the Nether, the glowing accents help your interface stand out in the dark and make every item slot feel alive with energy.
